title: The separator-based derivations for arrangements of monomial groups
summary: We investigate derivation modules of hyperplane arrangements associated with the monomial groups $G(r,p,\ell)$. Motivated by Mühlherr's separator-based construction for graphic arrangements, we extend this approach by combining separators with integral expressions. For a subarrangement $\mathcal{A}_G$ defined by a graph $G$, we show that, when $p<r$, the derivation module $\mathcal{D}(\mathcal{A}_G)$ is generated by the standard derivations $η_0,\dots,η_{κ(G)}$ together with a finite set of separator-based derivations. This result generalizes the complete graph case and provides new evidence…
